top_signals.title: U.S. and Iran pause fighting to give peace talks 'space.' Here's where negotiations stand
top_signals.summary: A temporary pause to the U.S.-Iran conflict appeared to hold on Monday, after negotiations over a lasting peace faced fresh hurdles over the weekend.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japanese author Keigo Higashino, known for penning intricate mystery novels, dies at 68
top_signals.summary: Higashino, a prolific writer lauded for his creativity, died of cancer, his official X account said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
